paite: Huan meipi puansilh a kizem van a kipan angel hat dang hong paikhesuk ka mu hi; alutung ah sakhituihup a-om a, amai nisa mah abang a, akhete mei khuamte bang mai ahi.
heading: Angel Hat Leh Laibu
english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

paite: Akhut a laibuzial neuchik honsa atawi a; akhe taklam a tuipi tung sik in akhe veilam leitung ah anga hi.
english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

paite: Humpinelkai humham bang in aw ngaihtak in akikou a; akikou khit in vanpiging sagihte'n a-aw uh asuah uhi.
english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

paite: Huan vanpiging sagihte'n a-aw uh asuahtak un gelh ding in ka kisa hi; van a kipan aw in, "Vanpiging sagihte' thugen iim bikbek inla gelhkhe ke'n,” achih ka za hi.
english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

paite: Huan tuipi tung leh leitung a angel dingh ka muh in van lam ah akhut taklam aliktou a;
english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky,

paite: huchi in huai tangtawn a hing van leh leitung leh asung a om tengteng leh tuipi leh asung a om tengteng siampa min lou in azekai nawnlouhna ding chi in akichiam hi.
english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

paite: Himahleh angel sagihna in amut ding pengkulpi agin chiang in, huai hun chiang in, "Pathian thuguk, asikha zawlneite kiang a agenkhiak tak hihkim in a-omta ding," chi in.
english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants, the prophets.

paite: Van a kipan a ka aw zak in kei hon houpih a, "Kuan inla, tuipi tung leh leitung a angel dingh khut a laibuzial neuchik honsa va la in,” achih ka za nawn hi.
english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

paite: Kei, angel kiang ah ka va hoh a, laibuzial neu hon pe ding in akiang ah ka va gen hi. Ama'n ka kiang ah, "La inla, ne zou vek in; huai in na gil hihkha in chin himahleh na kam ah khuaizu bang in akhum ding," achi hi.
english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it, and eat it up. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

paite: Huan angel khut a kipan in laibuzial neuchik ka la a, ka ne zou vek a; ka kam ah khuaizu bang in akhum a; huan ka nekzohtak in ka gil hihkhat in ahong om hi.
english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah, "Mi tampite leh namte leh paute leh kumpipate kiang ah Pathian thusuak na genkholh nawn ngeingei ding ahi," ahon chi hi.
english: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
